svg.aria-label: Four panels against time: TAI minus UTC steps from 10 to 37 seconds, TDB minus TT oscillates within about 1.7 milliseconds each year, and TCG minus TT and TCB minus TDB each drift steadily.
svg.text: TAI − UTC, s: a step at each leap second
TDB − TT, ms: a yearly cycle (2020 to 2024)
TCG − TT, s: a steady drift
TCB − TDB, s: a faster steady drift
